name: fluenttyper
description: Type less, do more. Get smart autocomplete, spell check, and text expansion to boost your productivity on any website.

scripts.test:e2e:production: bun run prepare:e2e:storage && bun run build:e2e:production && bun test --preload ./tests/bun-test-preload.ts --timeout 60000 --max-concurrency 1 tests/e2e/puppeteer-extension.test.ts tests/e2e/prodlike-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:dev: bun run prepare:e2e:storage && bun run build:e2e:dev && cross-env FT_E2E_DEV_RUNTIME=1 bun test --preload ./tests/bun-test-preload.ts --timeout 60000 --max-concurrency 1 --test-name-pattern="CMD_TOGGLE_FT_ACTIVE_LANG|AI predictor" tests/e2e/puppeteer-extension.test.ts && bun test --preload ./tests/bun-test-preload.ts --timeout 60000 --max-concurrency 1 tests/e2e/dev-options-predictor-toggle.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: bun run prepare:e2e:storage && bun run build:e2e:firefox && cross-env E2E_BROWSER=firefox bun test --preload ./tests/bun-test-preload.ts --timeout 60000 --max-concurrency 1 tests/e2e/puppeteer-extension.test.ts tests/e2e/prodlike-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:all: bun run test:e2e && bun run test:e2e:firefox
scripts.test:e2e:matrix: bun run test:e2e:production && bun run test:e2e:dev
